name: @singularity/brobot-admin-ui
description: brobot's admin site: Twitch sign-in, the chat command switches, the Pokémon leaderboard, team search, the last battle, and the OBS stream overlay.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/check-library-freshness.mjs --consumer apps/brobot-admin-ui --tsconfig tsconfig.spec.json && pnpm run test:library-resolution && ng test --watch=false
scripts.typecheck: node ../../scripts/check-library-freshness.mjs --consumer apps/brobot-admin-ui --tsconfig tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.spec.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.editor.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
